issue.title: bob-mac-capture tests do not compile on macOS CI: RefsNewestTests.zone clashes with NSObject.zone() and RefsLibraryTests uses a helper from another target

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic compile error, not a flake. Every bob-mac-capture macOS CI run from 2c007c7 (run 39164361288) through 12219ef (runs 39175284517 and 39176897995, bob-cli-9j's Mac commits) fails the Test step the same way: Lint and Build pass, then `swift test` stops at emit-module with `Tests/RefsCoreTests/RefsNewestTests.swift:12:16: error: getter for 'zone' with Objective-C selector 'zone' conflicts with method 'zone()' from superclass 'NSObject'`. Bundle, plist/signature, launch smoke, and install gates are skipped, and no XCTest runs at all. Linux `just portable-check` and the Mac stub `typecheck-tests` cannot see the XCTestCase/NSObject selector clash. Root cause: `static let zone` on `final class RefsNewestTests: XCTestCase`, added in 5a0bff5 (bob-cli-9d.2). bob-cli-9b.land recorded it as a DISCOVERED ISSUE on bob-cli-9d (note 2), but bob-cli-9d's landing closeout (note 3) closed without addressing or filing it. A second compile problem from the same epic is waiting behind it: `Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/RefsLibraryTests.swift:252,259,297,304` call `RefsNewestTests.instant(...)`, which lives in the separate RefsCoreTests target (reported by bob-cli-9k.7 note 1 from a scratch Mac typecheck-tests). Fix: rename the static (for example `newYork`) and its uses, give RefsLibraryTests its own instant helper or inline ISO dates, then confirm a green macOS CI Test step. That step also exposes the already-tracked Refs failures (bob-cli-8j, bob-cli-7h, bob-cli-7p, bob-cli-8e).

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-9j.land found the Mac CI Test step still failing on this compile error after bob-cli-9d closed without fixing or filing it, so no Mac XCTest (including the bob-cli-9j override banner and guard tests) has run on CI since 2c007c7.

payload.description: Six Refs* XCTest failures that surface once the Test step compiles again
Closed Refs Newest epic whose 5a0bff5 added the clashing static and the cross-target helper use

evidence.note: bob-cli-9k.land independent evidence: bob-mac-capture macOS CI run 39171275522 for e5cd4e1 (bob-cli-9k.7 idle agenda homes) passed Lint and Build but failed Test with the same compile error, so the 9k.7 macOS-only tests (CaptureAgendaDesignTests, CaptureAgendaHeightConsistencyTests additions) have never run on CI; latest 12219ef (run 39176897995) is still red. bob-cli-9k.7 note 1 is the RefsLibraryTests/RefsNewestTests half of this report.

bob-cli-9k.8.land independently checked CI run 39186590898 on bob-mac-capture 3a671761 (phase bob-cli-9k.8.4): Lint and Build pass; Test emit-module fails at RefsNewestTests.swift:12 because zone clashes with NSObject.zone(). This corroborates the limitation in 9k.8.4 note 1 and the proposal from 9k.7 note 1. Mac SSH still times out. No new homes-related compiler failure was reported by CI.

payload.description: Need the compile-error details before applying the ci_compile_fix branch

payload.entry: macOS CI run 39265058997 on 5fd928b (fix(tests): rename zone clash and localise instant helper) passed Lint and Build, then ran swift test through emit-module: 2568 tests executed. The Test step is no longer blocked on RefsNewestTests.zone vs NSObject.zone() or the cross-target RefsNewestTests.instant helper. Remaining 24 failures are the already-tracked runtime issues (bob-cli-8j, 7h, 7p, 8e), not compile errors.
